skript.thema: Whirl: open source AI chat app you can run yourself

teile.name: Problem
teile.text: Stop drowning in five different AI chat tabs. Whirl is an open source chat app that puts every top model in one conversation.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: a man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cluttered desk at night, rubbing his forehead, five glowing lamps of different colors crowding the desk, medium shot, neon light, calm top and bottom space.

teile.name: Das Werkzeug
teile.text: Can you run it yourself? Yes. The code is published in full under the MIT license, built on Next.js and Convex.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: close shot of an open laptop on a rooftop table at dusk, a hand resting on the keyboard, city skyline behind, warm orange light, the presenter's cyan glasses visible at the frame edge.

teile.name: Modelle
teile.text: Models are routed through OpenRouter, with adjustable thinking levels. So one conversation can replace several tabs.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: a switchboard of glowing cables and levers in a dim control room, one hand turning a dial, medium close shot, cyan and amber light, central action, calm edges.

teile.name: Gedaechtnis
teile.text: Long-term memory carries preferences and projects across chats. You don't have to explain yourself again in every new one.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: a worn notebook with pages being turned on a café table, a coffee cup beside it, soft window light, close shot, the presenter's black leather sleeve in frame.

teile.name: Dokumente
teile.text: Then comes the twist: living artifacts. Documents, charts and interactive pages stay editable in a side panel. You can share them by link.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: two colleagues at a workbench passing a sheet of paper between them, pinned sketches on the wall behind, wide-medium shot, warm studio light, action centered.

teile.name: Privatsphaere
teile.text: Locked chats are encrypted on your device, with a password the server never sees. Only zero-retention models answer them.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: a heavy brass padlock on a metal door in a rain-lit alley, a hand holding a key, close shot, cool blue light with a warm rim, calm top and bottom.

teile.name: Selbst betreiben
teile.text: Now the catch. You'll need Bun, a free Convex account, a Clerk application and an OpenRouter API key.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: the presenter in leather jacket and cyan glasses lays out four different tools on a garage workbench, medium shot, harsh overhead lamp, serious mood, central framing.

teile.name: Optionales
teile.text: Extras like web search, billing and analytics are optional. Leave out their keys, and Whirl hides those features.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: a wall panel of toggle switches, a hand flipping one off while others glow, close shot, teal and amber light, space above and below.

teile.name: Fazit
teile.text: So the answer to five tabs is one app you host yourself. Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world poster style: the presenter with cyan glasses closes a laptop on a balcony at sunrise, city rooftops behind, medium shot, warm golden light, relaxed mood, calm sky above.

The AI chat app that sweats the details. Every top model, real memory, living documents, and your own tools. - 502 stars, license: MIT, created 2026-10-02
PRIMARY MODEL/PROJECT DESCRIPTION (not independently tested):
Whirl 

 
  The AI chat app that sweats the details. Every top model, real memory, 
  living documents, and your own tools, in one fast and friendly place.
 

 
   whirl.chat  ·
   Self-hosting  ·
   Architecture  ·
   Contributing 
 

---

Whirl is a full-stack AI chat app built on Next.js and Convex. It's the code
behind [whirl.chat](https://whirl.chat), published in full under the MIT
license. Read it, run your own, or help make it better.

## Features

- **Every top model** in one conversation, routed through
  [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai), with adjustable thinking levels.
- **Living artifacts:** documents, charts, and full interactive pages that
  stay editable in a side panel and can be shared by link.
- **Integrations** with your own tools over MCP (OAuth included), plus
  installable skills that teach Whirl new tricks.
- **Long-term memory** that carries preferences and projects across chats.
- **Live web search** and page reading for answers grounded in today's web.
- **Locked chats**, encrypted on your device with a password the server never
  sees, answered only by zero-retention models.
- **Incognito mode**, message queueing, voice input, image generation, file
  attachments, folders, sharing, and a lot of care around motion and polish.
- **Light and dark mode**, accent colors, and an installable mobile web app.

## Tech stack

Everything beyond Convex, Clerk, and OpenRouter is **optional** and switches
on with its own keys: billing (Autumn), web search (Exa), memory
(Supermemory), analytics (PostHog, Axiom), tracing (Braintrust), email
(Resend), and the support agent (Median). Leave them out and Whirl hides the
features they power. See [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md).

## Quick start

You'll need [Bun](https://bun.sh), a free [Convex](https://convex.dev)
account, a [Clerk](https://clerk.com) application, and an
[OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) API key.

Open [localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) and say hi. The
[self-hosting guide](docs/self-hosting.md) covers each step in detail,
including the Clerk JWT template Convex needs and how to deploy to
production.

## Repository layout

## Documentation

- [Self-hosting](docs/self-hosting.md): run Whirl locally and in production
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every environment variable and
  what it switches on
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): how a message travels from the
  composer to the model and back
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): conventions, checks, and pull requests

## Contributing

Bug reports, ideas, and pull requests are all welcome. Start with
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), and please follow the
[code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Found a security issue? See
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
